_: Hand-maintained source for the grammar syllabus. tools/build-learning-data.py reads
it and writes data/learn/grammar.json; tools/build-grammar-questions.py turns it into
the drills in data/questions/L*-grammar-*.json. Never edit either of those by hand.
A point is one thing a learner can be shown, drilled on and scheduled. The fields:
level    the HSK level that first demands it
pattern  the shape, written the way a grammar reference would write it
gloss    English. Scaffolding for the path and study pages, not for the drills
note     Chinese. Printed with the drill, like every other note in the bank
needs    words that must already be taught. Anything outside the HSK list is
ignored for ordering — 动辄 is its own prerequisite and no syllabus
teaches it as vocabulary — but it is recorded here because it is true
after    points that must come first. A cycle is a build error
near     points a learner fuses with this one. Spaced apart, the way look-alike
characters are, and mined for distractors so the drills test the contrast
wrong    extra distractors, in the register the point belongs to
eg       [sentence, the span to blank, English]. The span must occur verbatim

points.title: A is B
points.gloss: 是 links two nouns and nothing else. It is not the verb 'to be' — an adjective takes 很, not 是.
points.note: 「是」连接两个名词。形容词前面不用「是」，用「很」。

points.title: Not
points.gloss: 不 negates verbs, adjectives and the present or future. It cannot negate 有.
points.note: 「不」否定动词和形容词。只有「有」用「没」否定。

points.title: Have not, did not
points.gloss: 没 negates 有 and completed actions. 不 says you will not; 没 says you did not.
points.note: 「没」否定「有」和已经发生的事。「不去」是不打算去，「没去」是没有去过。

points.title: Yes-no question
points.gloss: Put 吗 at the end of a statement and it becomes a question. Word order never changes.
points.note: 陈述句末尾加「吗」就是疑问句，语序不变。

points.title: And what about …?
points.gloss: 呢 bounces a question you have just been asked back at the other person, without repeating it.
points.note: 「呢」把刚问过的问题反问回去，不用重复整句。
eg: I am going to school, what about him?

points.title: What
points.gloss: A question word sits where the answer would sit. Chinese does not move it to the front.
points.note: 疑问词放在答案的位置上，不提到句子前面。

points.title: Who
points.gloss: 谁 asks about a person and takes the slot the person would occupy.
points.note: 问人用「谁」，问东西用「什么」。

points.title: Where
points.gloss: 哪儿 asks for a place. 哪 alone picks one out of several and needs a measure word.
points.note: 「哪儿」问地方；「哪」是从几个里挑一个，后面要加量词。

points.title: How many (under ten)
points.gloss: 几 expects a small number and always takes a measure word. 多少 expects any number and does not need one.
points.note: 「几」问十以下的数，后面一定要带量词；「多少」问的数可大可小。
eg: How many friends do you have?

points.title: How many, how much
points.gloss: 多少 asks an open quantity and is the only one of the two used for prices.
points.note: 问价钱只能用「多少钱」，不能用「几钱」。
eg: How many students are in your class?

points.title: Possessive and modifier 的
points.gloss: 的 hangs one thing off another. Close family and your own institutions usually drop it.
points.note: 「的」表示领属。家人和自己的单位后面常常省略：我妈妈、我们学校。
eg: 那个红色的杯子是我的。

points.title: To have, there is
points.gloss: 有 covers both possession and existence, and is negated only by 没.
points.note: 「有」既是「拥有」也是「存在」，否定只能用「没有」。
eg: There is a book on the table.

points.title: To be at
points.gloss: 在 puts something somewhere. 有 says a place contains something; 在 says a thing is located somewhere.
points.note: 「在」说的是人或东西在哪里；「有」说的是那个地方有什么。
eg: The book is on the table.

points.title: Adjectival predicate
points.gloss: An adjective is its own verb in Chinese. It needs a degree word in front of it — bare 我好 sounds like a comparison.
points.note: 形容词自己就是谓语，前面要加程度副词。只说「我好」听起来像在比较。

points.title: Too, extremely
points.gloss: 太…了 is one bracket, not two words. Dropping 了 leaves the phrase unfinished.
points.note: 「太……了」是一个整体，后面的「了」不能省。
eg: It is far too hot today.

points.title: All, both
points.gloss: 都 comes after what it sums up and before the verb — never at the front of the sentence.
points.note: 「都」放在它总结的那些人或事的后面、动词的前面。

points.title: Also
points.gloss: 也 sits before the verb, never at the end. It attaches to the subject that is doing the same thing.
points.note: 「也」放在动词前面，不能放句末。

points.title: Measure words
points.gloss: A number never touches a noun directly. 个 is the fallback, but the right measure word is part of the word.
points.note: 数词和名词之间一定要有量词。「个」是通用的，但每个名词都有自己合适的量词。

points.title: This and that
points.gloss: 这 and 那 also need a measure word before the noun, exactly as numbers do.
points.note: 「这」「那」后面同样要加量词才能接名词。

points.title: Completed action 了
points.gloss: 了 after the verb says the action finished. It is not a past tense — 明天我吃了饭就去 is future.
points.note: 动词后面的「了」表示动作完成，不是过去时。

points.title: Want to, would like to
points.gloss: 想 before a verb is a wish; before a noun it means to miss or think of.
points.note: 「想」后面接动词是「打算」，接名词是「思念」。
eg: I want to go to China.
What would you like to eat?

points.title: Can, having learned how
points.gloss: 会 is a skill you acquired. 能 is being in a position to. 可以 is being allowed to.
points.note: 「会」是学会的本领，「能」是有条件做，「可以」是被允许。

points.title: Can, being able to right now
points.gloss: 能 is about circumstance and capacity — the skill may be there, the conditions decide.
points.note: 「能」说的是条件允许、身体做得到，不是会不会。
eg: He can eat three bowls of rice.

points.title: To like
points.gloss: 喜欢 takes a noun or a whole verb phrase, with no preposition between them.
points.note: 「喜欢」后面可以直接接名词，也可以直接接动词短语。
eg: I very much like drinking tea.

points.title: Go and come
points.gloss: 去 moves away from where the speaker is, 来 towards it. The place follows the verb with no preposition.
points.note: 「去」是离开说话人，「来」是朝着说话人。地点直接跟在动词后面。

points.title: Time before the verb
points.gloss: When something happens is settled before the verb, not after it. English puts it at the end; Chinese does not.
points.note: 表示时间的词放在动词前面，不能放句末。

points.pattern: 年 → 月 → 号 → 星期
points.title: Dates, largest unit first
points.gloss: Chinese orders time from the biggest container to the smallest, the reverse of English.
points.note: 汉语的时间从大到小：年、月、号、星期、上午下午、点。
eg: Today is the fifth of March.

points.title: Clock time
points.gloss: 点 is the hour, 分 the minute, and 两点 is two o'clock — never 二点.
points.note: 钟点用「两点」不用「二点」；「分」是分钟。
eg: Class starts at half past eight.

points.title: Please
points.gloss: 请 opens a polite request and is followed straight by the verb.
points.note: 「请」后面直接接动词，是客气的说法。
eg: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
Please give me a glass of water.

points.title: And, between nouns only
points.gloss: 和 joins nouns. It does not join two clauses — English 'and' does both, Chinese does not.
points.note: 「和」只连接名词，不能连接两个句子。
eg: My friend and I are going.
Tea and water are both fine.

points.title: Localizers come after
points.gloss: Chinese marks place with a word after the noun, where English puts a preposition in front.
points.note: 表示位置的词放在名词后面：桌子上、家里、学校前面。
eg: The book is on the table.
There is a shop in front of the school.

points.title: In progress
points.gloss: 在 before the verb says the action is under way. 呢 at the end softens it; either alone is enough.
points.note: 「在」放在动词前表示动作正在进行，句末可以加「呢」。

points.title: Change of state 了
points.gloss: 了 at the end of the sentence reports that things are now different from before.
points.note: 句末的「了」表示情况发生了变化，和动词后的「了」不一样。
eg: I am not going after all.

points.title: Have ever done
points.gloss: 过 records an experience at some point in your life. 了 records that one particular action finished.
points.note: 「过」表示曾经有过这个经历，「了」表示某件事做完了。
eg: Have you ever eaten Peking duck?
He has never seen this film.

points.title: About to happen
points.gloss: 要…了 brackets an event that is close. 快要…了 and 就要…了 are the same shape, tighter.
points.note: 「快要……了」表示事情马上就要发生。
eg: The train is about to leave.
He will be here any moment.

points.title: Comparison with 比
points.gloss: 很 and 非常 cannot appear in a 比 sentence. Degree goes after the adjective: 大一点儿, 大得多.
points.note: 「比」字句里不能用「很」「非常」，程度放在形容词后面：大一点儿、大得多。
eg: This is a bit more expensive than that.

points.pattern: A 跟 B 一样 (+ Adj)
points.title: The same as
points.gloss: 跟…一样 states equality. Negate the 一样, not the 跟: 不一样.
points.note: 「跟……一样」表示相同，否定说「跟……不一样」。
eg: I am as tall as he is.
His book is not the same as mine.

points.pattern: A 没有 B (这么) Adj
points.title: Less than
points.gloss: 没有 is how you say 'not as … as'. 不比 means something else — it denies the comparison, it does not reverse it.
points.note: 「A没有B那么……」是「比不上」；「不比」只是否定「比」，意思不一样。
eg: I am not as tall as he is.
Today is not as cold as yesterday.
This is not as good as that.

points.title: A bit (and unwelcome)
points.gloss: 有点儿 goes before the adjective and carries a complaint. 一点儿 goes after it and is neutral.
points.note: 「有点儿」在形容词前，含不满意的意思；「一点儿」在形容词后，只表示程度小。
eg: It is a bit cold today.

points.title: A bit (neutral)
points.gloss: 一点儿 after an adjective asks for a small adjustment. 便宜一点儿 is a request; 有点儿便宜 is a remark.
points.note: 「一点儿」放在形容词后面，表示要求或比较的差别。
eg: Please speak a bit more slowly.
This one is a bit bigger.

points.title: How well it is done
points.gloss: 得 introduces a judgement of the action itself. With an object the verb repeats: 他说汉语说得很好.
points.note: 「得」后面说的是动作做得怎么样。带宾语时动词要重复：他说汉语说得很好。

points.title: Result complements
points.gloss: A second verb glued to the first says how it turned out. Negate the pair with 没, not 不.
points.note: 结果补语说明动作的结果，否定用「没」：没看见、没做完。
eg: The homework is not finished yet.

points.title: Direction complements
points.gloss: 来 and 去 after a verb say which way the motion runs relative to the speaker.
points.note: 「来」「去」放在动词后面，说明动作朝着说话人还是离开说话人。
eg: I will go up and have a look.

points.title: Because … therefore
points.gloss: Chinese keeps both halves of the pair. English drops one; leaving 所以 out here sounds unfinished.
points.note: 「因为」和「所以」常常一起出现，两个都说才完整。
eg: It rained, so I did not go.
因为他病了，所以没来上课。
He was ill, so he did not come to class.
我喜欢中国，因为这里的人很好。
I like China, because the people here are kind.

points.title: Although … still
points.gloss: Both halves stay. 虽然 does not cancel 但是 the way English 'although' cancels 'but'.
points.note: 「虽然」和「但是」要成对出现，汉语里两个都不省。
eg: 他虽然年轻，但是很有经验。
Young as he is, he is experienced.

points.title: Doing two things at once
points.gloss: Both actions run together. Each 一边 attaches to its own verb.
points.note: 「一边……一边……」表示两个动作同时进行。
eg: He walks and listens to music.
别一边吃饭一边看手机。
Do not eat and look at your phone.
我们一边喝茶一边聊天。

points.title: From … to
points.gloss: 从…到 spans time or space. Both markers stay put.
points.note: 「从……到……」表示时间或空间的起点和终点。
eg: It is far from Beijing to Shanghai.
I studied from eight to twelve.
How long does it take from here to school?

points.title: Distance from
points.gloss: 离 measures the gap between two fixed points. 从 marks a starting point you move away from.
points.note: 「离」说的是两点之间的距离，「从」说的是出发点。
eg: My home is near the school.
Is it far from here to the station?
There are three days until the exam.

points.title: Towards, to
points.gloss: 对 aims the action at someone. It comes before the verb, with the target between them.
points.note: 「对」引出动作的对象，放在动词前面。
eg: This is good for your health.

points.title: For, to
points.gloss: 给 names who benefits, and sits before the verb. As a main verb it means to give.
points.note: 「给」引出接受的人，放在动词前面；单独用时是「给予」的意思。
eg: Please give me a glass of water.

points.title: Make, let, have someone do
points.gloss: 让 hands the action to someone else. The person comes between 让 and the verb.
points.note: 「让」后面先说人，再说他做什么。
eg: Mum told me to come home early.
The teacher had us do homework.

points.pattern: 应该 / 可能 / 必须 + V
points.title: Should, might, must
points.gloss: These sit before the verb like 会 and 能, and negate with 不 in front of them.
points.note: 「应该」「可能」「必须」都放在动词前面，否定说「不应该」「不可能」。
eg: You must arrive by eight tomorrow.

points.title: Do not
points.gloss: 别 forbids. 不要 is the same instruction, one degree more formal.
points.note: 「别」和「不要」都是劝阻，「别」更口语。

points.title: Again, ahead and behind
points.gloss: 再 is an again that has not happened yet. 又 is one that already has.
points.note: 「再」用于还没发生的重复，「又」用于已经发生的重复。

points.title: Sooner than expected, later than expected
points.gloss: 就 says it happened earlier or more easily than you would think; 才 says later or with more effort.
points.note: 「就」表示比预想的早或容易，「才」表示比预想的晚或费劲。
eg: He was here as early as seven.
He did not come until nine.
I understood after a single read.

points.title: Or, in a question
points.gloss: 还是 offers a choice in a question; 或者 states one in a statement. They do not swap.
points.note: 疑问句里的「或者」要说「还是」；陈述句里才用「或者」。
eg: Tea or coffee, either is fine.

points.title: Every … all
points.gloss: 每 nearly always wants 都 later in the sentence. Leaving it out sounds incomplete.
points.note: 「每」后面的句子常常要有「都」呼应。
eg: He is late every single time.

points.title: Focusing on when, where or how
points.gloss: For an action already known to have happened, 是…的 asks not whether but how. 你是坐飞机来的吗 asks about the means.
points.note: 动作已经发生，要问或强调时间、地点、方式，就用「是……的」。
eg: When was it that you came?
I bought this book in Beijing.

points.title: Doubling the verb
points.gloss: Repeating a verb makes the action brief and casual — a try rather than a task.
points.note: 动词重叠表示动作时间短、语气轻松：看看、说一说。

points.title: Two of something
points.gloss: 两 counts things, 二 states the number. 两点 is two o'clock, 二月 is February.
points.note: 数东西用「两」，说数字本身用「二」：两个人、二月、十二。

points.title: Nearly
points.gloss: 快…了 measures nearness in time, the same bracket as 要…了 with the emphasis on speed.
points.note: 「快……了」强调时间上快到了。

points.title: Still, in addition
points.gloss: 还 says the situation has not stopped, or that there is more to add.
points.note: 「还」表示情况在继续，或者还有别的。
eg: I want to buy one more as well.
Do you have any other questions?

points.title: With, together with
points.gloss: 跟 pairs you with someone for the action. Before nouns it can also mean 和.
points.note: 「跟」引出一起做事的人，放在动词前面。
eg: I am going with a friend.

points.pattern: S 把 O + V + 结果
points.title: Disposal 把
points.gloss: 把 moves the object in front of the verb, because the sentence is about what was done to it. The verb can never stand bare — something must follow it.
points.note: 「把」把宾语提到动词前，强调对它做了什么处置；动词后面一定要有别的成分。
eg: He put the book on the table.

points.title: Passive 被
points.gloss: 被 makes the subject the one it happened to. 让 and 叫 do the same job in speech and need the agent named.
points.note: 「被」表示被动，主语是承受动作的一方；口语里也说「让」「叫」，但后面要说出施事。
eg: He was told off by the teacher.

points.title: More and more
points.gloss: 越来越 tracks change over time. 越 A 越 B ties one increase to another.
points.note: 「越来越」表示程度随时间加深；「越……越……」表示一方增加，另一方也跟着增加。
eg: The weather is getting colder and colder.
The more he talked the faster he got.
The rain got heavier and heavier.

points.title: As soon as
points.gloss: The second action follows the first immediately, and 就 is what does the joining.
points.note: 「一……就……」表示前一件事发生后紧接着就做后一件。
eg: 我一到家就给你打电话。
I will call you the moment I get home.
The students left the instant class ended.

points.title: Can and cannot, built into the verb
points.gloss: 得 or 不 dropped inside the verb-result pair says whether the result is achievable. 看不清楚 is not the same as 不能看清楚.
points.note: 可能补语说的是做不做得到：看得清楚、看不清楚。否定用「不」，不是「没」。
eg: I cannot see this character clearly.
There is too much, I cannot carry it.

points.pattern: 除了 A 以外，都/也 B
points.title: Except, besides
points.gloss: With 都 it excludes A; with 还 or 也 it includes A and adds more. The second half decides which.
points.note: 「除了……以外」后面用「都」是排除，用「还」「也」是包括在内。
eg: 除了他以外，大家都来了。
除了汉语，他还会说日语。
Besides Chinese, he also speaks Japanese.
除了星期天以外我都上班。
I work every day but Sunday.

points.title: Not only … but also
points.gloss: The second clause has to go further than the first. If it does not, the pair is wrong.
points.note: 「不但……而且……」后一句要比前一句更进一层。
eg: 他不但会说汉语，而且说得很好。
He not only speaks Chinese, he speaks it well.
这个菜不但好吃，而且便宜。
This dish is tasty and cheap besides.
她不但聪明，而且很努力。
She is clever and hard-working too.

points.title: If … then
points.gloss: 如果 sets a condition and 就 delivers the consequence. 的话 can close the first half instead.
points.note: 「如果……就……」表示假设；前半句也可以用「……的话」收尾。
eg: If it rains I will not go.
如果有时间，就来我家吧。
If you have time, come round.
你要是不舒服就早点休息。
If you are unwell, get some rest.

points.title: As long as
points.gloss: 只要 names the one thing that is enough. 只有…才 names the one thing without which nothing happens.
points.note: 「只要……就……」是充分条件，「只有……才……」是必要条件，两个不一样。
eg: As long as you work at it you can succeed.
I am happy so long as you come.
Whenever I have time I read.

points.title: Only if
points.gloss: 只有 marks the sole condition. Take it away and B cannot happen at all.
points.note: 「只有……才……」表示唯一的条件，没有它就不行。
eg: 只有努力，才能学好汉语。
Only through effort can you master Chinese.
Only if it rains will we not go.

points.title: First … then
points.gloss: 先…然后 sets an order of steps. 再 works the same way for the second step.
points.note: 「先……然后……」「先……再……」表示做事的先后顺序。
eg: Wash your hands first, then eat.
Let us buy tickets first and then go in.
他先学了三年，然后去了中国。
He studied three years and then went to China.

points.title: Both … and
points.gloss: 又…又 stacks two qualities that hold at once, usually adjectives.
points.note: 「又……又……」表示两种性质同时存在。
eg: This dish is cheap and tasty.

points.title: State held in place
points.gloss: 着 keeps the result of an action standing. 在 is the doing; 着 is what is left in place afterwards.
points.note: 「着」表示状态持续，「在」表示动作进行：门开着，他在开门。
eg: A painting hangs on the wall.

points.title: Starting up, and judged by trying
points.gloss: 起来 either starts an action or frames a judgement: 看起来 is 'looks', 听起来 is 'sounds'.
points.note: 「起来」可以表示动作开始，也可以表示从某个角度看：看起来、听起来。

points.title: Keep going
points.gloss: 下去 carries an action already under way further into the future.
points.note: 「下去」表示已经开始的动作继续进行。
eg: Keep at it and you will succeed.

points.title: Working it out
points.gloss: 出来 marks something becoming apparent — recognised, identified, produced.
points.note: 「出来」表示辨认出、想出、做出，从无到有。
eg: He came up with a plan.
Can you tell who it is?

points.title: When
points.gloss: 的时候 closes the clause it applies to. English opens with 'when'; Chinese closes with 的时候.
points.note: 「的时候」放在从句后面，不放前面。
eg: He was out when I came.
Do not look at your phone while eating.
When I was small I lived in Beijing.

points.title: Before and after
points.gloss: Both follow the event they anchor to, the reverse of English.
points.note: 「以前」「以后」放在事件后面：来中国以前、下课以后。
eg: 来中国以前我不会说汉语。
Before coming to China I could not speak it.
After class we will go and eat.

points.title: If, tacked on the end
points.gloss: 的话 turns the clause before it into a condition, and often pairs with 就.
points.note: 「……的话」把前面的句子变成假设，常和「就」搭配。
eg: If I have time I will go.
If you do not like it, do not eat it.
If it rains, let us make it another day.

points.title: Even
points.gloss: 连 pushes forward the least likely case, and 都 or 也 has to answer it.
points.note: 「连」提出最极端的例子，后面一定要有「都」或「也」。
eg: 这个字连老师都不认识。
Even the teacher does not know this character.
I do not have even one yuan.

points.title: No matter what
points.gloss: 不管 needs an open question or an either-or after it, and 都 in the second half.
points.note: 「不管」后面要跟疑问词或者两种可能，后半句用「都」。
eg: 不管天气怎么样，我都去。
I am going whatever the weather.
不管你说什么，他都不听。
He will not listen whatever you say.
Far or not, we are going.

points.title: Even if
points.gloss: 即使 grants a hypothetical and 也 refuses to let it change anything.
points.note: 「即使……也……」表示退一步说，结果还是不变。
eg: Even if it rains we are going.
Even if it is hard, try it.
即使他不来，我们也开始。
We will start even if he does not come.

points.title: In order to
points.gloss: 为了 states the aim and opens the sentence. 因为 states the cause; they are not interchangeable.
points.note: 「为了」说的是目的，「因为」说的是原因。
eg: 为了学好汉语，他去了中国。
He went to China in order to master Chinese.
I run every day for my health.
他为了工作搬到了上海。
He moved to Shanghai for work.

points.title: Extremely
points.gloss: 极了 comes after the adjective, unlike 很 and 非常 which come before it.
points.note: 「极了」放在形容词后面，「很」「非常」放在前面。

points.title: How many times
points.gloss: The count goes after the verb. With a noun object it usually goes between them.
points.note: 动量词放在动词后面：看了三次、说了一遍。
eg: I have seen it three times.
He has been to Beijing twice.

points.title: How long
points.gloss: Duration follows the verb, and when there is an object the verb is repeated: 学汉语学了三年.
points.note: 时量补语放在动词后面；带宾语时动词要重复：学汉语学了三年。
eg: I have studied Chinese for three years.

points.title: About, concerning
points.gloss: 关于 heads a topic; 对于 aims at a target. 关于 can open the sentence, 对于 usually attaches to the verb.
points.note: 「关于」引出话题，「对于」引出对象。
eg: 关于这个问题，我们再谈。
We will talk about this again.
这是一本关于中国历史的书。
This is a book about Chinese history.
对于这件事，我没有意见。
On this matter I have no view.

points.title: By means of
points.gloss: 通过 names the route or method that made the result possible.
points.note: 「通过」引出办法或途径。
eg: 通过这件事我学到了很多。
I learned a lot from this.
通过朋友介绍我认识了他。
I met him through a friend.

points.title: All along
points.gloss: 一直 runs the action or state without a break from then until now.
points.note: 「一直」表示动作或状态没有中断。
eg: I have been waiting for you all along.
Keep straight on and you are there.

points.title: Certainly, without fail
points.gloss: 一定 promises or insists. 不一定 means 'not necessarily', not 'certainly not'.
points.note: 「不一定」是「未必」，不是「一定不」。
eg: He may or may not come.

points.title: Roughly
points.gloss: 差不多 softens a number or a judgement to 'about' or 'nearly'.
points.note: 「差不多」表示大约、接近。
eg: We arrived at about the same time.

points.title: Even more
points.gloss: 更 raises a comparison already in play, and works inside a 比 sentence where 很 cannot.
points.note: 「更」表示在原有基础上再加一层，可以用在「比」字句里。
eg: He is even taller than me.

points.title: Always
points.gloss: 总是 reports a habit, often with a hint of complaint.
points.note: 「总是」表示习惯性地这样，常带一点不满。

points.title: Fairly
points.gloss: 比较 is a soft 'rather', weaker than 很 and with no explicit comparison stated.
points.note: 「比较」是「还算」的意思，程度比「很」轻。

points.title: Owing to
points.gloss: 由于 is the written 因为, and pairs with 因此 or 所以. It states cause, never purpose.
points.note: 「由于」是书面的「因为」，常和「因此」搭配；它说原因，不说目的。
eg: 由于天气不好，比赛推迟了。
The match was postponed owing to the weather.
由于时间有限，我们简单说说。
Time being short, we will keep it brief.
由于他的努力，问题解决了。
Thanks to his efforts the problem was solved.

points.title: Despite
points.gloss: 尽管 concedes something real, where 即使 supposes something hypothetical.
points.note: 「尽管」承认的是事实，「即使」假设的是没发生的事。
eg: 尽管很累，他还是坚持了。
Tired as he was, he kept going.
尽管下着雨，他们还是来了。
尽管我说了很多次，他还是忘了。
However often I said it, he still forgot.

points.title: Regardless
points.gloss: 无论 is the written 不管 and follows the same rule — an open question or an either-or after it.
points.note: 「无论」是书面的「不管」，后面同样要跟疑问词或两种可能。
eg: However hard it is, I will try.
It must be finished no matter what.

points.title: Since, given that
points.gloss: 既然 takes something both sides already accept and draws the conclusion from it. 因为 introduces news.
points.note: 「既然」说的是双方都已经知道的事实，「因为」才是提供新信息。
eg: 既然来了，就多坐一会儿。
Since you are here, stay a while.
既然你知道了，我就不说了。
As you already know, I will say no more.
既然不舒服，就早点休息吧。
Since you feel unwell, get some rest.

points.title: Not A but B
points.gloss: 而是 corrects. 就是 in the same slot means something entirely different — an either-or.
points.note: 「不是……而是……」是纠正，「不是……就是……」是二选一。
eg: He is not a teacher but a student.
The problem is not money but time.
This is not luck but effort.

points.title: Either A or B
points.gloss: One of the two is certainly the case, and 就是 is what makes it an alternative rather than a correction.
points.note: 「不是……就是……」表示二者必居其一。
eg: 他不是在看书，就是在写字。
He is either reading or writing.
丢东西的不是他就是我。
It was either him or me who lost it.

points.title: Surely not?
points.gloss: 难道 asks a question that expects to be denied. It is not asking for information.
points.note: 「难道」是反问，说话人已经有答案，不是真的在问。
eg: Do you mean he never told you?

points.title: What on earth
points.gloss: 到底 presses for a straight answer. It cannot appear with 吗 — the question word carries it.
points.note: 「到底」用在疑问句里追问，句末不能再加「吗」。
eg: What on earth are you trying to say?

points.title: Astonishingly
points.gloss: 竟然 marks the outcome as contrary to what anyone expected. 居然 is the same, a shade stronger in speech.
points.note: 「竟然」「居然」都表示出乎意料，「居然」语气更重。
eg: 他竟然忘了自己的生日。
He actually forgot his own birthday.
这么简单的题他居然做错了。
He got such an easy question wrong, of all things.

points.title: On the contrary
points.gloss: 反而 reports the opposite of what the situation led you to expect.
points.note: 「反而」表示结果和预想的相反。
eg: The medicine made it worse, not better.
The rain did not stop; it got heavier.
他不但没生气，反而笑了。
Far from being angry, he laughed.

points.title: To the point of
points.gloss: 甚至 pushes an example to its limit, one step beyond what came before it.
points.note: 「甚至」提出最极端的例子，比前面说的更进一步。
eg: He was so busy he even forgot to eat.
很多人不知道，甚至没听说过。
Many do not know, have not even heard of it.
He did not even leave a name.

points.title: And so
points.gloss: 于是 chains the next event to the last one. It reports sequence, not reasoning — 所以 does that.
points.note: 「于是」表示接着发生的事，「所以」表示由此得出的结论。
eg: 天黑了，于是我们回家了。
It grew dark, so we went home.
他没听懂，于是又问了一遍。
He did not follow, so he asked again.
The car broke down, so I walked.

points.title: Therefore
points.gloss: 因此 draws a conclusion in writing, and pairs naturally with 由于.
points.note: 「因此」是书面的「所以」，常和「由于」搭配。
eg: 他准备得很充分，因此考得很好。
He prepared thoroughly and so did well.
资料不足，因此结论不可靠。
The data is thin, so the conclusion is shaky.
价格上涨，因此销量下降。

points.title: Thereby
points.gloss: 从而 links a deliberate action to the result it produced. It never opens a sentence.
points.note: 「从而」表示前一个做法带来了后面的结果，不能放句首。
eg: 他改进了方法，从而提高了效率。
He improved the method and thereby raised efficiency.
政策放宽，从而带动了投资。
The rules eased, thereby drawing investment.
减少了浪费，从而降低了成本。
Waste fell and costs came down with it.

points.title: So that
points.gloss: 以便 states the convenience the first clause was arranged for. 免得 states the trouble it was arranged to avoid.
points.note: 「以便」说的是为了方便做某事，「免得」说的是为了避免某事。
eg: Leave a number so we can reach you.
早点出发，以便赶上火车。
Set off early so as to catch the train.
写清楚一点，以便别人看懂。
Write clearly so others can read it.

points.title: So as not to
points.gloss: 免得 names the nuisance being headed off, and always follows the precaution.
points.note: 「免得」后面说的是想避免的麻烦。
eg: Wrap up so you do not catch cold.
Leave early to avoid the traffic.
Say it plainly so there is no misunderstanding.

points.title: Can manage, cannot manage
points.gloss: 了 here is liǎo and means capacity — whether the amount can be handled at all.
points.note: 「V得了/V不了」的「了」读 liǎo，说的是做不做得完、受不受得住。
eg: I cannot eat all this food.
Can you manage it on your own?
With rain like this we cannot go.

points.title: In time, too late
points.gloss: A fixed pair about time only. 来不及 says the clock beat you, not that you lacked skill.
points.note: 「来得及」「来不及」只说时间够不够，和会不会没有关系。
eg: There is still time if we go now.
I have no time for breakfast.
来得及的话就再检查一遍。
Check it again if there is time.

points.pattern: 一方面 A，一方面 B
points.title: On one hand … on the other
points.gloss: Two aspects of one situation held together, not two options to choose between.
points.note: 「一方面……一方面……」说的是同一件事的两个方面。
eg: 一方面要工作，一方面要照顾家。
There is work on one side and family on the other.
一方面是钱的问题，一方面是时间。
他一方面高兴，一方面又担心。
He was pleased and worried at once.

points.pattern: 一 + MW + 也/都 + 不/没
points.title: Not a single one
points.gloss: The smallest possible quantity plus 也 or 都 makes an absolute denial.
points.note: 「一……也不/都没……」是彻底的否定。
eg: I am not the least bit tired.
He did not say a word.

points.title: However much
points.gloss: 再 here concedes any degree at all, and 也 refuses to let it matter.
points.note: 「再……也……」表示不管程度多高，结果都一样。
eg: However hard it is, it must be done.
However busy you are, you must eat.
There is no point saying more.

points.pattern: 怎么 V 也 + 不/没
points.title: No matter how you try
points.gloss: An open question word plus 也 covers every method and denies them all.
points.note: 「怎么……也……」表示用什么办法都不行。
eg: However hard I think, I cannot recall it.
这个门怎么推也推不开。
The door will not open however I push.
He will not listen whatever you say.

points.title: To cause someone to feel
points.gloss: 使 and 令 are written causatives, mostly with feelings. 让 is the spoken one and covers instructions too.
points.note: 「使」「令」多用于书面，后面常接感受；口语用「让」。

points.title: Written 把
points.gloss: 将 does the job of 把 in formal writing, and also marks future time before a verb.
points.note: 「将」是书面的「把」，也可以放在动词前表示将来。
eg: The meeting will be held tomorrow.

points.title: Literary passive and 所 clauses
points.gloss: 为…所 is the written passive. 所 alone before a verb turns it into what is done: 我所知道的.
points.note: 「为……所……」是书面的被动；「所」加动词表示「……的事物」：我所知道的。

points.title: Which shows that
points.gloss: 可见 draws an inference from evidence just given. 因此 draws a consequence; 可见 draws a conclusion about what must be true.
points.note: 「可见」是从前面的事实推出结论。
eg: 他每天都来，可见很认真。
He comes daily, which shows he is serious.
The book is worn, so it is clearly well read.
大家都同意，可见这个办法不错。
All agreed, which shows the plan is sound.

points.title: In short
points.gloss: 总之 closes a list and states what it all comes to.
points.note: 「总之」用来总结前面说的内容。
eg: 总之，这件事要重新考虑。
At all events it must be done by tomorrow.

points.title: Not as good as, better to
points.gloss: 不如 both compares unfavourably and proposes a better course.
points.note: 「不如」既表示比不上，也表示建议换一个更好的做法。
eg: Today is not as hot as yesterday.
The bus is slower than walking.

points.title: Merely
points.gloss: 光 in speech and 仅 in writing both narrow to one thing and nothing else.
points.note: 「光」是口语，「仅」是书面，都表示「只」。
eg: This item alone cost twenty thousand.
光他一个人就搬了十箱。

points.title: Easy to, hard to
points.gloss: 好 and 难 before a verb say how easy the thing is to do, not how well it is done.
points.note: 「好」「难」放在动词前，说的是容易不容易：好吃、难写。
eg: This character is hard to write.
His handwriting is hard to read.

points.title: Unless
points.gloss: 除非 names the only thing that would change the outcome, and 否则 states what happens without it.
points.note: 「除非……否则……」表示唯一的例外条件。
eg: 除非下雨，否则我们照常出发。
Unless it rains we set off as planned.
I will go only if you do.
除非有急事，否则别打电话。
Do not ring unless it is urgent.

points.title: Along with
points.gloss: 随着 ties one change to another that follows it in step.
points.note: 「随着」表示一件事跟着另一件事一起变化。
eg: 随着年龄增长，他越来越安静。
He grew quieter as he aged.
随着经济发展，生活好了。
Life improved as the economy grew.
随着时间过去，他慢慢忘了。

points.title: According to
points.gloss: 按照 follows a rule or plan; 根据 rests on evidence or a source.
points.note: 「按照」跟的是规定和计划，「根据」跟的是依据和材料。
eg: Use it according to the instructions.
根据调查，情况正在好转。
The survey shows things are improving.
按照计划，我们下周出发。
Under the plan we leave next week.

points.title: As far as N is concerned
points.gloss: 对…来说 frames whose viewpoint the judgement belongs to.
points.note: 「对……来说」表示从谁的角度看。
eg: For me this is not hard.
对学生来说，时间最宝贵。
For students time is the most precious thing.
For him it is the first time.

points.title: Not merely
points.gloss: 不仅 is the written 不但, and the second clause still has to go further than the first.
points.note: 「不仅」是书面的「不但」，后一句仍要更进一层。
eg: He can not only speak it but write it.
This is not merely a question of money.
不仅学生喜欢，老师也喜欢。
Not just the students like it — the teachers do too.

points.title: However
points.gloss: 然而 is the written 但是, and turns the sentence harder than 不过 does.
points.note: 「然而」是书面的「但是」，转折比「不过」重。
eg: 他很努力，然而没有成功。
He worked hard; even so he did not succeed.
计划很好，然而执行得不好。
The plan was good, but poorly carried out.
天气不好，不过我们还是去了。
The weather was bad, but we went anyway.

points.title: Conversely
points.gloss: 相反 sets the next statement directly against the last one.
points.note: 「相反」引出和前面完全相对的情况。
eg: 他并不生气，相反还笑了。
Far from angry, he actually laughed.
Prices did not fall; on the contrary they rose.
It is not hard — quite the reverse.

points.title: Even if, at the extreme
points.gloss: 哪怕 supposes the least likely case and 也 holds the outcome steady. 就算 is its spoken twin.
points.note: 「哪怕」和「就算」都是极端的假设，后面用「也」。
eg: 哪怕只有一个人来，我也讲。
I will speak even if only one person comes.
It is worth it whatever it costs.

points.title: Even supposing
points.gloss: 就算 is the conversational 即使 and leans towards conceding an argument.
points.note: 「就算」是口语里的「即使」，常用于让步。
eg: 就算他不来，我们也开始。
We will start even if he does not turn up.
就算你说得对，也应该客气点。
Even granting you are right, be civil.
It does not matter even if it fails.

points.title: Once, should it happen
points.gloss: 一旦 looks ahead to a decisive moment and what follows from it. 一…就 is about immediacy, not consequence.
points.note: 「一旦」着眼于将来关键的一步，「一……就……」强调时间紧接。
eg: 一旦决定了，就不要后悔。
Once you decide, do not look back.
一旦出问题，后果很严重。
Should anything go wrong, it will be serious.
Once started it has to be finished.

points.title: Any and all
points.gloss: 凡是 sweeps in every member of a category and 都 confirms none is excepted.
points.note: 「凡是」把符合条件的全部包括进来，后面用「都」。
eg: Everyone who comes gets a gift.
凡是他说的话我都相信。
凡是超过一年的都要重新申请。
Anything over a year must be reapplied for.

points.title: In case, on the off chance
points.gloss: 万一 supposes something unlikely and unwelcome, and prepares for it.
points.note: 「万一」假设的是可能性很小又不希望发生的事。
eg: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
What if he does not come?
It would be a nuisance if it got lost.

points.title: Lest
points.gloss: 以免 is the written 免得 and names the outcome being guarded against.
points.note: 「以免」是书面的「免得」，后面说要避免的结果。
eg: 请提前通知，以免影响工作。
Give notice in advance so as not to disrupt work.
注意安全，以免发生事故。
Take care lest an accident occur.

points.title: On the strength of
points.gloss: 凭 names what you rely on to do something — a document, a skill, a claim.
points.note: 「凭」引出依靠的东西：凭票、凭本事。
eg: 他凭自己的努力成功了。
He succeeded on his own efforts.
On what grounds do you say that?

points.title: To depend on
points.gloss: 靠 is the everyday word for relying on someone or something to get by.
points.note: 「靠」表示依靠，语气比「凭」口语。
eg: You cannot leave this to others.
Only what you do yourself is dependable.

points.title: Aimed at
points.gloss: 针对 points a measure squarely at a particular problem or group.
points.note: 「针对」表示专门对着某个问题或对象。
eg: This policy is aimed at young people.
针对这个问题，我们做了调查。
The course is designed for beginners.

points.title: As for
points.gloss: 至于 turns to a new topic that the last one raised but did not settle.
points.note: 「至于」把话题转到另一件相关的事上。
eg: 时间定了。至于地点，还要商量。
The time is fixed; as for the venue, we must discuss it.
As for the cost, the company covers it.
至于他为什么走，没人知道。

points.title: Take A as B
points.gloss: A written frame that assigns a role: 以质量为主 puts quality first.
points.note: 「以……为……」是书面格式，表示把前者当作后者。
eg: The firm treats quality as its lifeblood.

points.title: Regard A as B
points.gloss: 把…当作 is the spoken counterpart of 以…为, and needs 把 to move the object forward.
points.note: 「把……当作……」是口语的「以……为……」。
eg: 他把这里当作自己的家。
He treats this place as his own home.
Do not take a joke for the truth.
I regard him as a friend.

points.title: Take A for instance
points.gloss: 拿…来说 introduces one case as evidence for the point being made.
points.note: 「拿……来说」举一个例子来说明观点。
eg: 拿这件事来说，就很清楚。
Take this case — it is plain enough.
With Chinese, say, tones are the hardest part.
拿去年来说，收入增加了。
Last year, for one, income rose.

points.title: In N's view
points.gloss: 在…看来 attributes the opinion to someone. 对…来说 states whom it affects.
points.note: 「在……看来」是谁的看法，「对……来说」是对谁而言。
eg: To my mind this is no problem.
In his view effort matters most.
在很多人看来，这很奇怪。
To many people this seems odd.

points.title: Judging from
points.gloss: 从…来看 names the angle the judgement is made from.
points.note: 「从……来看」表示从哪个角度判断。
eg: As things stand it looks fine.
从价格来看，这个更合适。
On price this one suits better.
从这一点来看，他是对的。
On that score he is right.

points.title: Can afford it
points.gloss: 得起 and 不起 speak of what you can bear — the price, or the loss of face.
points.note: 「买得起」是钱够，「对不起」「看不起」是另一种「起」。
eg: Who can afford housing at these prices?
He has no respect for that sort of thing.

points.title: Worth doing
points.gloss: 值得 takes a verb directly and judges the exchange worthwhile.
points.note: 「值得」后面直接接动词。
eg: It is not worth getting angry over.

points.title: Bound to happen
points.gloss: 免不了 accepts something as unavoidable, usually a nuisance.
points.note: 「免不了」表示避免不了，多用于不好的事。
eg: Moving is bound to cost money.
A beginner is bound to be nervous.

points.title: And go on to
points.gloss: 进而 moves to a further step built on the one before. 从而 reports a result; 进而 reports a next move.
points.note: 「进而」是在前一步的基础上再做一步，「从而」说的是结果。
eg: 先了解情况，进而提出办法。
Understand it first, then go on to propose a fix.
他学会了基础，进而研究理论。
He mastered the basics and moved on to theory.
改进流程，进而降低成本。
Improve the process and go on to cut costs.

points.title: In view of
points.gloss: 鉴于 is a formal 由于, used where a decision is being justified.
points.note: 「鉴于」是很正式的「由于」，多用于做出决定的场合。
eg: 鉴于时间紧张，会议改期。
In view of the tight schedule the meeting is postponed.
鉴于他的表现，公司决定加薪。
Given his performance the company raised his pay.
鉴于以上原因，我不同意。
For the reasons above I disagree.

points.title: And moreover
points.gloss: 并且 adds a second action or quality of equal weight. 而且 raises the stakes; 并且 keeps them level.
points.note: 「并且」是平行地增加一项，「而且」是更进一层。
eg: 他答应了，并且很快就做了。
He agreed, and did it promptly too.
The method is simple and effective.
我们讨论了，并且做了决定。
We discussed it and reached a decision.

points.title: Only, but
points.gloss: 不过 turns the sentence gently — a qualification rather than a contradiction.
points.note: 「不过」的转折比「但是」轻，是补充说明。
eg: Good stuff, only a little pricey.
I would like to go, but there is no time.

points.title: Yet, and it sits inside
points.gloss: 却 marks a reversal but belongs before the verb, not at the head of the clause.
points.note: 「却」表示转折，位置在主语后、动词前，不能放句首。
eg: Tired as he is, he is still working.
Much was said, yet nobody listened.
It is cheap, and yet well made.

points.title: Lies in
points.gloss: 在于 names where the essence of something is located — a written equative.
points.note: 「在于」指出关键或本质所在。
eg: The trouble is that there is not enough time.

points.title: No longer
points.gloss: 不再 stops something that used to hold. 再不 threatens instead.
points.note: 「不再」是从此不这样了，「再不」是威胁或催促。
eg: He does not come any more.
I am not waiting any longer.
It is no longer quiet here.

points.title: As regards
points.gloss: 就…而言 narrows the claim to one aspect, in formal register.
points.note: 「就……而言」把话限定在某一个方面，语体正式。
eg: In terms of quality this is better.
For the present there is no problem.

points.title: Up until
points.gloss: 到…为止 closes a span at a stated point.
points.note: 「到……为止」表示到某个时间或程度就结束。
eg: 到今天为止，还没有消息。
As of today there is still no news.
到上个月为止，共有三百人。
Up to last month there were three hundred.

points.title: Ever since
points.gloss: 以来 measures from a past point up to now, and follows the event.
points.note: 「以来」表示从过去某时到现在，放在时间词后面。
eg: 来中国以来，我认识了很多朋友。
Since coming to China I have made many friends.
三年以来他一直住在这里。
He has lived here these three years.
He has not taken a day off since term began.

points.title: Apart from this
points.gloss: 除此之外 is the written 除了这个以外, and opens the next item in a list.
points.note: 「除此之外」是书面的「除了这个以外」。
eg: 除此之外，还有别的问题。
Apart from this there are other problems.
Other than that I have no comment.
除此之外，费用也是个问题。
Besides this, cost is an issue too.

points.title: Not necessarily
points.gloss: 不见得 doubts a claim without denying it. 不一定 is its everyday equivalent.
points.note: 「不见得」是「未必」，不是否定，只是表示怀疑。

points.title: So that someone can
points.gloss: 好让 states the purpose in terms of what it enables another person to do.
points.note: 「好让」引出目的，重点在让别人能做什么。
eg: 请说慢点，好让大家听清楚。
Speak slowly so everyone can follow.
Leave the light on so he can find his way.
Write it down so you will remember.

points.title: Never again
points.gloss: 再也 with a negative closes the door for good.
points.note: 「再也不」「再也没」表示从此以后不再这样。
eg: I am never going there again.
再也找不到这样的机会了。
Such a chance will never come again.

points.title: Cannot help but
points.gloss: 不免 says the reaction was unavoidable given the circumstances.
points.note: 「不免」表示这种反应免不了会产生。
eg: 听到这个消息，他不免有些失望。
Hearing this he could not help feeling let down.
A first time on stage is bound to be nerve-racking.
Recalling it, he could not help feeling sad.

points.title: Could not help doing
points.gloss: 不禁 is about an action escaping you — laughing, crying, exclaiming — not a state of mind.
points.note: 「不禁」后面是忍不住做出的动作，「不免」后面多是心理状态。
eg: 听到这里我不禁流下眼泪。
At that point I could not hold back tears.
The room broke into applause despite itself.

points.title: Hard to avoid
points.gloss: 难免 concedes that something unwelcome is difficult to prevent, and can sit before a noun phrase too.
points.note: 「难免」表示不容易避免，可以做谓语，也可以修饰后面的句子。
eg: Mistakes at work are hard to avoid.
Being young, he is bound to be thoughtless.
Doing it this way will surely cause misunderstanding.

points.title: Not advisable
points.gloss: 不宜 judges an action unsuitable in the present circumstances. 不必 says it is unnecessary.
points.note: 「不宜」表示现在这样做不合适，「不必」表示没有必要。
eg: 事情还没查清，不宜下结论。
With the facts unclear it is unwise to conclude.
One should not exercise straight after eating.
This should not be made public.

points.title: It would not go so far as
points.gloss: 不至于 denies that things will reach the extreme being feared.
points.note: 「不至于」表示不会严重到那个地步。
eg: 再忙也不至于连饭都不吃。
However busy, one hardly skips meals entirely.
He would never go so far as to say that.
情况没那么糟，不至于失败。
It is not so bad as to fail.

points.title: Why bother
points.gloss: 何必 uses a question to say there was no need. 何况 adds a stronger reason instead.
points.note: 「何必」用反问表示没有这个必要，「何况」是更进一层。
eg: 这点小事，何必惊动大家。
Such a trifle — why trouble everyone?
他已经道歉了，你何必生气？
He has apologised; why stay angry?

points.title: Let alone
points.gloss: 何况 adds a case even more obvious than the one just made, often after 连…都.
points.note: 「何况」提出比前面更明显的理由，常和「连……都……」呼应。
eg: 大人都搬不动，何况孩子。
Even adults cannot lift it, let alone children.
Busy at the best of times, still more so now.
他连汉字都不认识，何况写文章。
He cannot read the characters, let alone write essays.

points.title: Rather than … better to
points.gloss: 与其…不如 rejects the first course and picks the second. 宁可…也不 accepts a cost to avoid something worse.
points.note: 「与其……不如……」是否定前者、选择后者；「宁可……也不……」是甘愿承受代价。
eg: 与其抱怨，不如想办法解决。
Rather than complain, find a fix.
Better to go yourself than wait for him.
与其买新的，不如修一修。
Rather than buy new, get it mended.

points.title: Would rather … than
points.gloss: 宁可 takes on a hardship deliberately to avoid something judged worse.
points.note: 「宁可……也不……」表示两害相权，甘愿选前者。
eg: 宁可走路，也不坐那么久的车。
I would sooner walk than sit that long on a bus.
他宁可自己吃亏，也不让朋友为难。
He would take the loss himself rather than embarrass a friend.
宁可慢一点，也不能出错。

points.title: If, in writing
points.gloss: 倘若 is the literary 如果, and belongs in formal prose.
points.note: 「倘若」是书面语的「如果」，多用于正式文字。
eg: 倘若明天下雨，运动会就延期。
Should it rain tomorrow the sports day is postponed.
倘若有困难，请及时联系。
Should difficulties arise, do get in touch.
If true, the consequences are grave.

points.title: Supposing
points.gloss: 假如 supposes a case for the sake of argument, slightly more hypothetical than 如果.
points.note: 「假如」用于假设，语气比「如果」更像是设想。
eg: 假如你是我，你会怎么做？
Supposing you were me, what would you do?
假如再来一次，我还是这样选。
Given the chance again I would choose the same.
假如没有他，就没有今天。
But for him there would be no today.

points.title: Rather too
points.gloss: 未免 registers a mild objection that something has gone a bit far. 未必 doubts a claim instead.
points.note: 「未免」是委婉地说「有点过分」，「未必」是「不一定」。
eg: That is rather too harsh a way to put it.
The price is somewhat on the high side.

points.title: Not necessarily
points.gloss: 未必 is the written 不一定 and doubts without denying.
points.note: 「未必」是书面的「不一定」，表示怀疑而不是否定。
eg: What he says may well not be true.

points.title: Granted that
points.gloss: 固然 concedes a point in order to make a different one. 虽然 simply admits a fact.
points.note: 「固然」先承认对方有理，再提出自己的看法；「虽然」只是陈述事实。
eg: 这样做固然省事，但不安全。
Convenient it may be, but it is not safe.
他固然聪明，可是不够努力。
Clever he is, but not diligent enough.
价格固然重要，质量更重要。
Price matters, of course; quality matters more.

points.title: Nothing more than
points.gloss: 无非 reduces something to a small point, dismissing what looked bigger.
points.note: 「无非」表示说到底只不过是这样，含轻视的意味。
eg: What he said amounts to no more than this.
There are only two reasons, really.
It is nothing but a bid for attention.

points.title: Comes down to
points.gloss: 不外乎 says the possibilities do not extend past the list about to be given.
points.note: 「不外乎」表示范围就这么大，跳不出这几种。
eg: The reasons come down to these few.
结果不外乎成功或失败。
The outcome is either success or failure.

points.title: With the result that
points.gloss: 以致 introduces a bad consequence. 以至于 can also mark a degree so great it produced the result.
points.note: 「以致」后面是不好的结果；「以至于」还可以表示程度深到某种地步。
eg: 他没有认真检查，以致出了大错。
He did not check carefully, with the result that a serious error slipped through.
雨下得太大，以至于路都断了。
The rain was so heavy the road was cut.

points.pattern: A 之所以 B，是因为 C
points.title: The reason A is B is that C
points.gloss: 之所以 puts the result first and the cause last — the reverse of 因为…所以.
points.note: 「之所以……是因为……」把结果放前、原因放后，和「因为……所以……」顺序相反。
eg: 他之所以成功，是因为一直努力。
He succeeded because he never stopped trying.
之所以选这里，是因为方便。
We chose here for the convenience.
我之所以不说，是因为不想麻烦你。
I kept quiet so as not to trouble you.

points.title: For one thing … for another
points.gloss: 一来…二来 lists reasons in order, in a conversational register.
points.note: 「一来……二来……」用来分条说明原因。
eg: 一来时间不够，二来钱也不够。
For one thing there is no time, for another no money.
Too far, and too dear besides.
一来他不愿意，二来我们也不勉强。
He is unwilling, and we will not press him.

points.title: Now this, now that
points.gloss: 时而…时而 alternates two states irregularly over time.
points.note: 「时而……时而……」表示两种情况交替出现。
eg: The weather turns from sun to rain and back.
He is cheerful one moment, cross the next.

points.title: At the slightest thing
points.gloss: 动辄 marks a reaction that comes far too readily, and disapproves of it.
points.note: 「动辄」表示动不动就这样，带批评的意思。
eg: He loses his temper at the least thing.
动辄批评别人是不对的。
Criticising others at every turn is wrong.
Prices run to tens of thousands as a matter of course.

points.title: Only through
points.gloss: 唯有 is the literary 只有 and keeps the same 才 in the second clause.
points.note: 「唯有」是书面的「只有」，后面同样用「才」。
eg: Only by persevering can one succeed.
True knowledge comes only from practice.
He alone knows the inside of it.

points.title: Only this one, and no other
points.gloss: 惟独 singles one case out against everything else in the set.
points.note: 「惟独」把一个从整体里单独挑出来，和别的都不一样。
eg: 大家都同意，惟独他反对。
别的都好，惟独这一点不行。
All the rest is fine; only this will not do.
Today of all days he did not come.

points.title: Would that not …?
points.gloss: 岂不 asks rhetorically and expects agreement — a literary 难道不.
points.note: 「岂不」是书面的反问，等于「难道不……吗」。
eg: If all did so, would there not be chaos?

points.title: Can it be that …?
points.gloss: 莫非 voices a suspicion the speaker half believes already.
points.note: 「莫非」表示猜测，说话人心里已经有了答案。
eg: Can it be that he already knows?
这么晚还不来，莫非出事了？
So late — can something have happened?

points.title: When have I ever …?
points.gloss: 何尝 denies through a question — 我何尝说过 means I never said it.
points.note: 「何尝」用反问表示从来没有，等于「并不是」。
eg: As if I did not want to go.
He never said any such thing.
Not for a moment have we forgotten.

points.title: For the moment
points.gloss: 姑且 accepts something provisionally, pending something better.
points.note: 「姑且」表示暂时先这样，以后再说。
eg: Let us leave this question aside for now.
Let us try it for the time being.
We will take his word this once.

points.title: Might as well
points.gloss: 不妨 suggests there is no harm in trying, softening a recommendation.
points.note: 「不妨」表示这样做没有什么妨碍，是一种建议。
eg: You might as well ask him.
It is worth looking at it another way.
There is no harm in trying this first.

points.title: Might as well go the whole way
points.gloss: 索性 abandons half-measures and takes the decisive course.
points.note: 「索性」表示干脆彻底地这样做。
eg: 既然来了，索性多住几天。
Since you are here, stay a few days more.
No bus came, so he simply walked home.
Let us have it out plainly.

points.title: Is bound to
points.gloss: 势必 predicts an outcome as the inevitable consequence of the situation.
points.note: 「势必」表示照这个趋势一定会这样。
eg: Carry on like this and trouble is bound to follow.
成本上升势必影响价格。
Rising costs will inevitably affect prices.
It is bound to provoke discussion.

points.title: It is true that
points.gloss: 诚然 grants the other side's point openly before turning.
points.note: 「诚然」先承认对方说得对，然后提出自己的看法。
eg: 诚然，他有他的道理，但结论太急了。
True, he has a point, but the conclusion is hasty.
Even so, there is no need for gloom.

points.title: And even
points.gloss: 乃至 extends a list to its furthest member. 甚至 does the same job in speech.
points.note: 「乃至」是书面的「甚至」，把范围推到最远的一项。
eg: 这项技术影响全国乃至世界。
The technology affects the country and even the world.
几天乃至几个月都有可能。
It could be days or even months.
他的作品在本地乃至海外都有读者。
His work is read locally and even abroad.

points.title: And then, following on
points.gloss: 继而 marks the next stage in a sequence, more formal than 然后.
points.note: 「继而」表示紧接着发生的下一步，比「然后」正式。
eg: He was startled at first, then laughed.
雨点落下，继而成了大雨。
Drops fell, and then it poured.
Pilot it first, then roll it out.

points.title: Once it has been done
points.gloss: 一经 marks a step that, once taken, settles the matter. 一…就 only marks immediacy.
points.note: 「一经」表示经过这一步以后事情就定了，语体正式。
eg: Once found it is dealt with at once.
The contract takes effect once signed.

points.title: What is called
points.gloss: 所谓 introduces a term about to be defined, or flags one the speaker doubts.
points.note: 「所谓」引出要解释的说法，有时也带怀疑的口气。
eg: 所谓效率，就是用最少的时间做最多的事。
Efficiency means doing the most in the least time.
所谓的专家其实并不懂。
The so-called expert does not actually understand.
